deliverables.name: Workflow review findings
deliverables.description: Annotated review of the lead-capture workflow with 6 findings, each tied to a specific node or log entry.

deliverables.name: Prioritised fix list
deliverables.description: 6 fixes ranked by impact/effort. The batching timeout and the missing retry on the enrichment API are the two high-impact items.

deliverables.name: Applied quick-win: enrichment API retry
deliverables.description: Adds a 3-attempt exponential backoff to the enrichment HTTP node. This is the single change most likely to stop the intermittent data loss.

assumptions_made: The enrichment API is the main source of timeouts (supported by the error log: 71% of errors are on that node).
Free n8n nodes only, since the open question about paid nodes was unresolved at start of work.
Pipedrive field mapping must stay unchanged (per the constraint).

changes_made.description: Added exponential backoff (3 attempts) to the enrichment HTTP Request node.
changes_made.impact: Should eliminate the majority of intermittent data loss from transient API failures.
changes_made.test_results: Ran the patched workflow against a 50-lead sample with a simulated 20% API failure rate; 0 leads lost vs 9 lost on the original.

tests_performed.description: 50-lead sample run with simulated API failures, original vs patched.
tests_performed.notes: Original lost 9/50; patched lost 0/50. Latency increased ~1.2s per retried lead, within acceptable range.

tests_performed.description: Confirmed Pipedrive field mapping unchanged after patch.
tests_performed.notes: Diffed the Pipedrive node config; no changes.

unresolved_issues.issue: Batch-size timeout on runs above ~300 leads.
unresolved_issues.reason: Fixing properly needs a redesign to chunk batches, which is beyond a 2-hour review scope.
unresolved_issues.recommended_next_action: Scope a follow-up engagement to add batch chunking; estimated 2–3 hours.

recommendations: Apply the included patch first; it's the lowest-risk, highest-impact change.
Resolve the paid-node question — a single queue node would solve the batch timeout cleanly.
Add a dead-letter capture so any future lost lead is recoverable rather than silently dropped.
notes: Productive time was 105 minutes of the estimated 120. Billing reflects actual productive time.
